Requirement title: Организация одна; каждая общая запись ограничена organization boundary.
UserAccount отвечает за аутентификацию, EmployeeProfile — за рабочий профиль.
Сервер является единственным источником истины; локальный cache disposable и read-only при outage.
Любое действие разрешается сервером по RBAC/ReBAC/ABAC, explicit deny сильнее allow, default deny.
Business status, derived state, archive, trash и UI state не смешиваются.
Archived object по умолчанию read-only; Trashed object доступен только для restore/purge.
Удаление metadata рабочего файла не удаляет физический файл.
Физический доступ к файлу определяется Windows/SMB ACL после metadata permission.
Versioned write требует If-Match; stale version не перезаписывается молча.
Safe retry допускается только для safe/idempotent operation с сохранением request hash/key.
Audit append-only; secrets и неразрешённые sensitive paths редактируются или не записываются.
Realtime signal является invalidation; durable recovery выполняется через change feed.
Search фильтруется по authorization и filters до pagination; client post-filter запрещён.
UI hidden/disabled state не заменяет server-side permission check.
PATCH omitted означает unchanged; explicit null очищает только nullable field.
Analytics не хранит полный query, PII, paths, secrets или notification contents; product/diagnostic/audit разделены.

Requirement title: [Platform] Desktop client supports corporate Windows 10/11 editions approved by the company.
Test type: Versioned install/launch/sign-in/logout smoke matrix on each approved corporate image; 0 failed required step.

Requirement title: [Desktop] All primary/destructive actions, CMP-001 and CMP-002 have keyboard-only paths.
Test type: Automated UIA plus manual keyboard matrix; exact focus-return and disabled-reason assertions for every listed flow.
Source: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation (NFR catalog NFR-002)

Requirement title: [Accessibility] Focus is visible/deterministic; urgency levels/bounds and employee group/status/redaction have accessible names and states.
Test type: UIA tree snapshot + Narrator/NVDA script for loading, result-group, redaction, validation, conflict, unavailable and close/Esc states.
Source: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation (NFR catalog NFR-003)

Requirement title: [High DPI] Layouts remain usable at 100–200% Windows scaling and multiple monitors.
Test type: Window-size × scaling × high-contrast visual/keyboard matrix on approved Windows images.

Requirement title: [Color] Status/urgency/error/redaction is never communicated by color alone; semantic text and icon/shape alternatives are present.
Source: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation (NFR catalog NFR-005)

Requirement title: [Performance] Large lists use server pagination and client virtualization.
Test type: Production-scale fixture profile: request log, page/cursor assertions, realized-item count and memory trend.

Requirement title: [Calendar] Calendar reads are range-bounded and virtualized.
Test type: Generated contract/UI tests for minimum/maximum supported ranges, DST boundaries and one over-limit range.

Requirement title: [Search] Filtering and cursor pagination execute server-side before result delivery.
[Resilience] Server outage changes application to honest read-only cache mode.
[Recovery] After reconnect client authenticates, applies change feed, and bootstraps when cursor/scope is invalid.
[Concurrency] All versioned writes, including urgency scale PUT/reset, require If-Match and reject stale/missing version.
Source: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation (NFR catalog NFR-011)

Requirement title: [Idempotency] Idempotent commands do not duplicate side effects for same key/hash.
[Security] Server evaluates authentication, capability, relation, employee visibility/redaction and filters before pagination on every request.
Source: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation (NFR catalog NFR-013)

Requirement title: [Security] Tokens, passwords, secrets, raw query, PII, notification content and sensitive full paths are absent from logs/analytics.
Source: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation (NFR catalog NFR-014)

Requirement title: [Transport] Client-server traffic uses approved TLS inside local network.
Test type: Deployment endpoint scan and negative TLS handshake/certificate matrix inside the approved LAN configuration.

Requirement title: [Local data] User-specific cache is encrypted, disposable and cleared on logout/revoke/scope changes as specified.
[Errors] Client maps all Stage 2.3.1 stable errors, cursor invalidation and redaction/unavailable states without raw exceptions.
Source: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation (NFR catalog NFR-017)

Requirement title: [File safety] Application never deletes or moves physical working files as a metadata side effect.
[File access] OS/SMB ACL remains authoritative and failures are categorized.
[Compatibility] Unsupported clients are blocked for writes; Stage 2.3.1 notification clients retain built-in urgency presentation mapping.
Source: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation (NFR catalog NFR-020)

Requirement title: [Audit] Audit/history is append-only and authorization/redaction aware.
[Backup UX] Admin UI shows backup result, last success and verification status; backup bytes are not exposed.
[Scale] Candidate is designed for up to 300 active employees, 100 concurrent connections and approximately 2M tasks/events.
[Availability] The product candidate does not assert an unapproved numeric availability SLA, RPO or RTO. Deployment must reference a company-approved operational policy before production approval.
Test type: PRD token scan plus deployment-policy presence/approval/link check; numeric objectives are tested only after company approval.
Source: Stage 1 architecture §0.5 and §18 require company approval; OQ-008 closed as an external deployment-policy gate, not a product value. (NFR catalog NFR-024)

Requirement title: [Request limits] Requests, text and batch sizes respect OpenAPI/Stage 2.3.1 limits.
Source: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation (NFR catalog NFR-025)
